canonical_graph_observer.artifacts: external module component, basename, exists=true, kind, positive bytes and SHA256
canonical_graph_observer.components: module group/name/version or local project path
canonical_graph_observer.edges: from/to typed component identities, boolean constraint
canonical_graph_observer.unresolved_dependencies: Actual task failure with unresolved markers; not omitted

exporter.incompatible_native_flat_observer_output: Warm8 native observer observations do not supply canonical edges/configuration schema and must not be substituted or reshaped to pretend graph evidence.
exporter.module_without_artifact_allowed: Selected metadata/platform module retained explicitly with no reported AAR/JAR bytes.
exporter.normal_export_can_overwrite_paths: Root must reserve fresh filenames and refuse pre-existing outputs before invoking; --check then reproduces exact bytes.

reader.font_payload_match_and_NOTICES_Z_gzip_re: Actual reported evidence requiring root assessment; reader status pass alone does not establish content completeness.
reader.font_records: Unique label, family, asset bundle relative asset path, physical source path and lowercase SHA256.
reader.input_records: Unique label, opaque role, physical absolute path and lowercase SHA256; hashes/identity before and after read.

schema_validation.scope: Offline Draft7 CycloneDX1.6 structure only; no source freshness, advisory, rights or artifact mapping acceptance.

source_SBOM: source_sbom.py separately verifies inventory-recorded source hashes/fork membership/assets. Its current source is bound, but no new broad inventory or source-SBOM generation is proposed here. Graph and artifact scope remain separate.
